Medical practice SEO, Dallas

Medical SEO in Dallas, TX: Be the Practice Patients Find When They Search "Doctor Near Me" or Ask AI

Dallas patients now find a practice through three overlapping routes: Google search, Google Maps, and AI assistants that summarize options. All three rely on the same underlying facts: your physicians, services, offices, reviews and how consistently they are stated. Medical SEO in Dallas is the work of making those facts accurate and complete, then measuring which searches become calls and appointment requests.

We serve Dallas practices from our Houston base, remotely, and have no Dallas office. We are a marketing and website agency, not a medical provider.

Availability depends on specialty and ZIP code. In the Dallas area, primary care is reserved in Dallas, Plano and Fort Worth; cardiology in Red Oak; ERs in Plano, McKinney and Rockwall. Reserved practices can request a complimentary audit.
Request a free Dallas practice review

The problem

Why a well-run Dallas practice still loses the search to a hospital-system template page

Dallas health systems publish consistent location and physician directories at scale. Independent practices often have better care and worse data. These are the gaps we see most.

One services page for twenty services

Patients searching for a specific service land on a list, and Google has nothing specific to rank.

Physicians without real pages

No page, or a page with a photo and a sentence, so neither patients nor AI tools can describe the physician.

Location data that disagrees with itself

Hours, suite numbers and phone lines differ across the website, Google and directories.

No way to tell what worked

Calls and forms are not tracked by page or source, so marketing spend cannot be judged.

Two funnels: your patients' path and your path to us

  1. Patient searchesFor example 'cardiologist near me'
  2. Patient comparesMaps, reviews, physician pages
  3. Patient contactsCall or request form
  4. Practice reviews usFree visibility review
  5. Practice decidesScope-based proposal

Patient phrases are examples of what your patients type, not keyword-volume data.

What we improve

What a Dallas medical practice engagement actually changes

We commit to the work and the reporting. Rankings, Maps positions and AI mentions are outcomes we influence, not ones we can promise.

Technical repair first

Speed, errors, forms, security and structured data, so later work is not built on a broken base.

Google profiles per location

One accurate profile and page for each office, with practitioner details where appropriate.

Service, condition and physician pages

Pages that answer what patients ask, approved by your clinicians, linked into a clear structure.

Consistent business identity

Name, address, phone, hours and services aligned across the site, Google and key directories.

Review process

A compliant routine for requesting and responding to reviews, run by your staff.

Appointment path and measurement

Clear calls to action and tracking of calls and requests by page and source.

Internal links run in one direction on purpose: articles lead to condition pages, condition pages to service pages, service pages to physician and location pages, and those to the appointment request or call. More: healthcare SEO, AI search optimization.

How we work

The implementation flow for a Dallas practice

Remote delivery from Houston, with one practice contact, a shared task list and monthly reviews.

  1. Free visibility review

    Screen-shared look at search, Maps and AI answers for your practice.

  2. Assess

    Full audit of site, listings, directories, reviews and tracking.

  3. Fix foundations

    Technical repair, location data and measurement.

  4. Build content

    Physician, service and condition pages in the agreed order.

  5. Measure and refine

    Monthly report separating more activity from qualified inquiries.

What you can verify

Proof and expertise

  • Operating since 2013; WevTEC is a DBA of Bizzsol LLC, registered in Texas.
  • 1,000+ websites repaired; 500+ designed or redesigned.
  • Live, screen-shared reviews instead of PDFs days later.

We publish client results only with the client’s permission, a timeframe, a baseline and the method. Without that permission, we show our process instead of inventing numbers.

Dallas coverage

Dallas areas, competition and specialty availability

For a new Dallas client we first investigate the ZIP areas around each office, then the wider Dallas–Fort Worth cities patients travel from, such as Plano, Irving, Garland and Richardson, which are separate municipalities with their own search patterns.

Primary care is reserved in Dallas, Plano and Fort Worth. We offer a complimentary audit and consultation instead.

Texas availability overview

Scope, timing and investment

Included work is agreed in the proposal: technical repair, location data, content in an agreed order, tracking and reporting. Timing depends on site condition, content approval speed and competition. Cost depends on the number of offices and physicians, site repairs needed, and whether you want Google Ads. Proposals list the management fee, ad spend paid to Google, one-time website work and optional services separately; cancel with 7 days’ notice. See the cost guide and the healthcare marketing hub.

Questions practice owners ask

Medical practice SEO in Dallas: direct answers

Answers for Dallas owners and administrators.

Why does our practice appear for its name but not for its services?

Usually because services have no dedicated pages, office data is inconsistent, or reviews and profile categories do not mention them. Name searches only need your brand; service searches need evidence that you offer that service at that location.

What should an agency inspect before recommending a budget?

Your site’s technical condition, each office’s Google profile, directory consistency, reviews, existing content, any ads account and your tracking. Without that, a budget is a guess.

Does AI search change what a medical practice needs to do?

It raises the value of clear, consistent facts and direct answers, but it does not replace SEO fundamentals. We improve readiness; we never promise an AI citation.

How do we distinguish more activity from qualified inquiries?

Track calls and forms by page and source, and, where your team can, note which became appointments. Traffic and clicks alone do not show quality.

What can the agency control, and what can't it?

We control the work: repairs, pages, listings, campaigns and reporting. We cannot control proximity, competitors, algorithm changes, payer mix or your scheduling capacity.

Do you work with another practice in our specialty nearby?

We take one practice per specialty within defined ZIP codes. Send your office addresses and we will tell you plainly.

Do we need a medical marketing agency located in Dallas?

Not necessarily. We serve Dallas remotely from Houston and say so. Judge agencies on evidence, reporting and responsiveness.

Start with a free practice visibility review

Have your website, office addresses and main services ready. We confirm availability first.
